title: Bangi language
description: Bantu language spoken in Congo and DRC
extract: The Bangi language, or Bobangi, is a relative and main lexical source of Lingala spoken in central Africa. Dialects of the language are spoken on both sides of the Ubangi and the Congo rivers.
